payload.description_html: Skulls of different members of the Ceratopsidae, a group of ornithischian dinosaurs. Original caption: “Skulls of Horned Dinosaurs. The lower row, Chasmosaurus, Styracosaurus, Monoclonius, are from the Middle Cretacic (Belly River formation) of Alberta; Anchiceratops is from the Upper Cretacic (Edmonton formation) of Alberta; Triceratops and Torosaurus from the uppermost Cretacic (Lance formation) of Wyoming.”
